The bar and the apartments would go solely to me. My mom is worried she won't get anything when he does pass away, so she constantly asks if I'll give her half of the bar. I personally want nothing to do with the bar due it being a cause for my parent's alcoholism. My mom says I should just give it all to her if that's the case. I would ask her to at least buy out my half, but she has been mentally abusive to me for most of my life, and constantly sabotaged anything I've done to try and better my own life. I've recently thought about just selling my quarter of the house to my siblings, and the entire bar to them or anyone else who wants it. WIBTA if I decided to leave my mom out of anything I get from my dad's will?
